questions.skill: Check a graphical estimate with an inverse matrix
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: The system y = 0.5x + 2 and y = -2x + 4 is written -0.5x + y = 2 and 2x + y = 4. Find the determinant of the matrix A with rows [-0.5 1] and [2 1].
questions.prompt_markup: The system y = 0.5x + 2 and y = -2x + 4 is written -0.5x + y = 2 and 2x + y = 4. Find the determinant of the matrix A with rows [-0.5 1] and [2 1].
questions.grading_note: Any equivalent form. (-0.5)(1) - (1)(2) = -2.5.

questions.skill: Check a graphical estimate with an inverse matrix
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A⁻¹ is (1 ÷ (-2.5)) times the matrix with rows [1 -1] and [-2 -0.5]. Use X = A⁻¹B, with B the column [2, 4], to find the exact solution.
questions.prompt_markup: A⁻¹ is (1 ÷ (-2.5)) times the matrix with rows [1 -1] and [-2 -0.5]. Use X = A⁻¹B, with B the column [2, 4], to find the exact solution.
questions.grading_note: Form required: both values. (1 ÷ (-2.5)) times the column [2 - 4, -4 - 2].

questions.skill: Check a graphical estimate with an inverse matrix
questions.standard_level: Precalculus. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Precalculus, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: A graph shows two lines crossing near (1.3, 2.3). The inverse-matrix solution is (4/3, 7/3). Which statement is true?
questions.prompt_markup: A graph shows two lines crossing near (1.3, 2.3). The inverse-matrix solution is (4/3, 7/3). Which statement is true?

choices.text: The two results contradict each other.
The graph is exact; the matrix method is approximate.
The graph gives an estimate; the matrix method gives the exact solution.

questions.correct_answer: The graph gives an estimate; the matrix method gives the exact solution.
questions.grading_note: 4/3 ≈ 1.33 and 7/3 ≈ 2.33, which match the estimate.

questions.grading_note: Then A has an inverse and X = A⁻¹B.
